BOOST_EXT_G4_FP_2016_010_07.q: Arjun is 47 years old and Riya is 9 years old. What was the difference in their ages 6 years ago?
hints: Here's a key insight: the age difference between two people never changes.
It doesn't matter if we go forward or backward in time.
The difference was, is, and always will be 38 years.
steps: The age difference never changes!
The difference is 47 minus 9, which is 38.

BOOST_EXT_G4_FP_2017_018_06.q: Arjun is 27 years old and Riya is 28 years old. What will be the sum of their ages after 10 years?
hints: Add 10 years to each person's age.
Then add their future ages together.
Both age by 10 years, so total increases by 20.
steps: After 10 years: Arjun is 37, and Riya is 38.
The sum is 37 plus 38, which is 75.

BOOST_EXT_G4_FP_2017_018_07.q: Siya is 40 years old and Aditya is 34 years old. What was the difference in their ages 10 years ago?
hints: Here's a key insight: the age difference between two people never changes.
It doesn't matter if we go forward or backward in time.
The difference was, is, and always will be 6 years.
steps: The age difference never changes!
The difference is 40 minus 34, which is 6.

BOOST_EXT_G4_FP_2019_005_07.q: Riya is 26 years old and Rohan is 11 years old. What was the difference in their ages 3 years ago?
hints: Here's a key insight: the age difference between two people never changes.
It doesn't matter if we go forward or backward in time.
The difference was, is, and always will be 15 years.
steps: The age difference never changes!
The difference is 26 minus 11, which is 15.

BOOST_EXT_G4_FP_2022_035_06.q: Tara is 35 years old and Dev is 31 years old. What will be the sum of their ages after 4 years?
hints: Add 4 years to each person's age.
Then add their future ages together.
Both age by 4 years, so total increases by 8.
steps: After 4 years: Tara is 39, and Dev is 35.
The sum is 39 plus 35, which is 74.

EXT_G4_FP_2021_010.q: The sum of the ages of a mother and daughter, 5 years ago, was 5 x. What will the sum be, 5 years hence?
hints: This is an age problem with two people. When time passes, each person gets older, so the sum of their ages grows for both of them.
From 5 years ago to 5 years from now is 10 years. Think about how much each of the two people adds to the sum in that time.

Similar example: 3 years ago, the ages of a father and son added up to 40. From 3 years ago to 3 years from now is 6 years. Two people each grow 6 years older, so the sum grows by 2 times 6, which is 12. The sum 3 years from now is 40 plus 12, which is 52.
steps: From 5 years ago to 5 years from now is 10 years.
There are two people, the mother and the daughter. Each one grows 10 years older, so the sum grows by 20. 2 times 10 equals 20.
The sum 5 years ago was 5 x. So the sum of their ages 5 years from now is 5 x plus 20.

EXT_G4_FP_2021_019.q: The ages of a husband and wife, 6 years ago, added up to 48. At present, the husband, wife and son add up to 63. What is the son's age, 6 years hence?
hints: This is an age problem. First bring everyone to the same time, the present, before you compare the sums.
Find the sum of the husband's and wife's ages now. Two people each grew 6 years older since then.

Similar example: 4 years ago a father's and mother's ages added up to 50. Now their sum is 50 plus 2 times 4, which is 58. Father, mother and daughter add up to 66 now, so the daughter is 66 minus 58, which is 8 now. In 4 years she will be 8 plus 4, which is 12.
steps: 6 years ago the husband and wife together were 48. Each is 6 years older now, so add 12. 48 plus 2 times 6 equals 60.
Now all three together are 63. Take away the husband and wife to get the son's age now. 63 minus 60 equals 3.
Add 6 years to find the son's age 6 years from now. 3 plus 6 equals 9.
The son will be 9 years old.

EXT_G4_FP_2022_035.q: The sum of the ages of Nirav and Vipul, 3 years ago, was 38. What is Vipul's age after 2 years, if he is 2 years younger than Nirav?
hints: This is an age problem about two people. Bring the sum to the present first, then split it using the difference in their ages.
Find the sum of their ages now. Each of the two boys is 3 years older than he was 3 years ago.

Similar example: 2 years ago the ages of Asha and Ravi added up to 26. Now the sum is 26 plus 2 times 2, which is 30. Ravi is 4 years younger, so take 4 away and halve: 30 minus 4, then divided by 2, is 13. Ravi is 13 now. After 3 years he will be 13 plus 3, which is 16.
steps: 3 years ago the sum was 38. Both are 3 years older now, so add 6. 38 plus 2 times 3 equals 44.
Vipul is 2 years younger. Take away Nirav's 2 extra years, then share equally. 44 minus 2, then divided by 2, equals 21.
Vipul is 21 now. Add 2 years. 21 plus 2 equals 23.
After 2 years Vipul will be 23 years old.

G4A_AGES_001.q: Asha is 9 years old now. How old will she be after 6 years?
hints: As the years pass, a person's age goes up by the same number of years.
Add the 6 years to Asha's age now.
Example: Raju is 7 now. After 5 years he will be 7 plus 5, which is 12 years old.
steps: Asha is 9 now.
After 6 years her age goes up by 6: 9 plus 6 equals 15.
So Asha will be 15 years old.

G4A_AGES_002.q: Meera is 10 years old and her father is 38 years old. How many years older than Meera is her father?
hints: The words how many years older ask for the gap between the two ages.
Subtract Meera's age from her father's age.
Example: a boy is 8 and his mother is 33. She is 33 minus 8, which is 25 years older.
steps: Her father is 38 and Meera is 10.
38 minus 10 equals 28.
So her father is 28 years older.

G4A_AGES_003.q: Tina is 8 years old. Her mother is 4 times as old as Tina. How old is her mother?
hints: The words times as old tell you to multiply.
Multiply Tina's age by 4.
Example: Sunil is 6 and his father is 5 times as old, so his father is 6 times 5, which is 30.
steps: Tina is 8.
Her mother is 4 times as old: 8 times 4 equals 32.
So her mother is 32 years old.

G4A_AGES_004.q: Four years ago, Zoya was 6 years old. How old is she now?
hints: The words years ago take you into the past. Coming back to today, the age goes up.
She was 6 then, and 4 years have passed since. Add.
Example: three years ago Kabir was 9, so now he is 9 plus 3, which is 12.
steps: Four years ago Zoya was 6.
Since then 4 years have passed: 6 plus 4 equals 10.
So Zoya is 10 years old now.

G4A_AGES_005.q: Dev was born in the year 2015. How old was he on his birthday in 2024?
hints: Age on a birthday is the number of years from the birth year to that year.
Subtract the birth year from 2024.
Example: someone born in 2010 turns 2021 minus 2010, which is 11, on the birthday in 2021.
steps: Dev was born in 2015.
2024 minus 2015 equals 9.
So Dev was 9 years old on his birthday in 2024.

G4A_AGES_006.q: Rohan's father is 36 years old. Rohan is one-third as old as his father. How old is Rohan?
hints: One-third as old means the age is split into 3 equal parts and you take one of them.
Divide the father's age by 3.
Example: a mother is 40 and her son is one-quarter as old, so the son is 40 divided by 4, which is 10.
steps: His father is 36.
One-third of 36 is 36 divided by 3, which is 12.
So Rohan is 12 years old.

G4A_AGES_007.q: Anil is 3 years older than his brother Sunil today. How many years older than Sunil will Anil be after 10 years?
hints: Think about what happens to both brothers as the years go by. Do they grow older at the same pace?
Try it with ages you choose: say Sunil is 5 and Anil is 8. Find both ages after 10 years.
Example: Rita is 4 years older than Gita. If Gita is 6 and Rita is 10, then after 5 years they are 11 and 15, and Rita is still 15 minus 11, which is 4 years older.
steps: Suppose Sunil is 5, so Anil is 8.
After 10 years Sunil is 15 and Anil is 18.
18 minus 15 equals 3. Both grow older by the same amount, so the gap stays the same.
So Anil will still be 3 years older.

G4A_AGES_008.q: Ravi is 12 years old now. In how many years will he be 20 years old?
hints: You know the age now and the age later. The number of years in between is the gap.
Subtract Ravi's age now from 20.
Example: Simran is 9 now. She will be 15 in 15 minus 9, which is 6 years.
steps: Ravi is 12 now and will be 20 later.
20 minus 12 equals 8.
So Ravi will be 20 in 8 years.

G4A_AGES_009.q: Amit is 3 years older than Bina. Bina is 2 years older than Chirag. Chirag is 7 years old. How old is Amit?
hints: Start from the person whose age you know and work along the chain, one person at a time.
Chirag is 7 and Bina is 2 years older. Find Bina's age first.
Example: Pari is 4 years older than Qasim, Qasim is 1 year older than Ria, and Ria is 6. Then Qasim is 7 and Pari is 7 plus 4, which is 11.
steps: Bina is 2 years older than Chirag: 7 plus 2 equals 9.
Amit is 3 years older than Bina: 9 plus 3 equals 12.
So Amit is 12 years old.

G4A_AGES_010.q: Farhan is 11 years old. His sister Rehana is 3 years younger than him. How old was Rehana 2 years ago?
hints: Find the sister's age now first. Then go back in time.
Rehana is 3 years younger than Farhan: 11 minus 3.
Example: Mohan is 16 and his sister is 2 years younger, so she is 14. Five years ago she was 14 minus 5, which is 9.
steps: Rehana's age now: 11 minus 3 equals 8.
Two years ago she was 2 years younger: 8 minus 2 equals 6.
So Rehana was 6 years old.

G4A_AGES_011.q: Diya is 7 years old and her mother is 35 years old. After 7 years, how many times as old as Diya will her mother be?
hints: Both people grow older. Find both new ages first, then compare them by dividing.
After 7 years, Diya will be 7 plus 7 and her mother will be 35 plus 7.
Example: a boy is 4 and his father is 34. After 2 years they are 6 and 36, and 36 divided by 6 equals 6, so the father is 6 times as old.
steps: After 7 years Diya will be 7 plus 7, which is 14.
Her mother will be 35 plus 7, which is 42.
42 divided by 14 equals 3.
So her mother will be 3 times as old as Diya.

G4A_AGES_012.q: The sum of the ages of Anu and her mother is 44 years. Anu is 8 years old. How old was her mother when Anu was born?
hints: Find the mother's age now. Then go back to the year Anu was born.
Mother's age now: 44 minus 8.
Example: a boy of 5 and his father have ages adding up to 40. The father is 35 now, and when the boy was born, 5 years ago, he was 35 minus 5, which is 30.
steps: Mother's age now: 44 minus 8 equals 36.
Anu was born 8 years ago.
Her mother was then 36 minus 8, which is 28.
So her mother was 28 years old when Anu was born.

G4A_AGES_013.q: The ages of two sisters add up to 20 years. One sister is 4 years older than the other. How old is the older sister?
hints: You know the sum and the difference of two ages. Take away the extra years and the rest splits equally.
Take the extra 4 years away from 20. What is left is twice the younger sister's age.
Example: two ages add up to 34 and differ by 6. 34 minus 6 equals 28, and half of 28 is 14, so the younger is 14 and the older is 14 plus 6, which is 20.
steps: Take away the extra years: 20 minus 4 equals 16.
Half of 16 is 8, so the younger sister is 8.
The older sister is 8 plus 4, which is 12.
So the older sister is 12 years old.

G4A_AGES_014.q: A father is 3 times as old as his son. Their ages add up to 48 years. How old is the son?
hints: Think of the son's age as 1 part. Then the father's age is a number of the same parts, and you can count all the parts in the sum.
The son is 1 part and the father is 3 parts. That makes 4 parts adding up to 48.
Example: a mother is 4 times as old as her daughter and their ages add up to 40. That is 5 parts, so the daughter is 40 divided by 5, which is 8.
steps: The son is 1 part and the father is 3 parts, so together they are 4 parts.
4 parts are 48, so one part is 48 divided by 4, which is 12.
So the son is 12 years old.

G4A_AGES_015.q: Three years ago, Kiran was 9 years old. How old will she be 4 years from now?
hints: Move along the timeline in two jumps: from the past to today, then from today to the future.
First find Kiran's age today: 9 plus 3.
Example: four years ago Jai was 5, so he is 9 now. Two years from now he will be 9 plus 2, which is 11.
steps: Kiran's age today: 9 plus 3 equals 12.
Four years from now: 12 plus 4 equals 16.
So Kiran will be 16 years old.

G4A_AGES_016.q: The ages of Geeta and Hari add up to 25 years now. What did their ages add up to 3 years ago?
hints: Going back in time changes the age of each person, not just one. Count how many people are in the sum.
Three years ago Geeta was 3 years younger, and so was Hari. How much smaller was the sum?
Example: two friends' ages add up to 30. Five years ago each was 5 years younger, so the sum was 30 minus 5 minus 5, which is 20.
steps: Three years ago Geeta was 3 years younger and Hari was 3 years younger.
Together that is 3 plus 3, which is 6 years less.
25 minus 6 equals 19, so their ages added up to 19 years.

G4A_AGES_017.q: Jay's grandfather is 72 years old. Jay's father is half as old as the grandfather. Jay is one-quarter as old as his father. How old is Jay?
hints: Work down the family one step at a time, using each age to find the next.
Find the father's age first: half of 72.
Example: a grandmother is 60, the mother is half as old, so 30, and the child is one-fifth as old as the mother: 30 divided by 5 equals 6.
steps: Father's age: 72 divided by 2 equals 36.
Jay's age is one-quarter of 36: 36 divided by 4 equals 9.
So Jay is 9 years old.

G4A_AGES_018.q: Varun is 9 years old. His father is 27 years older than him. How old will his father be when Varun is 15?
hints: The gap between two people's ages stays the same for ever. Use it at the later time.
When Varun is 15, his father will still be 27 years older than him.
Example: Nita is 6 and her mother is 24 years older. When Nita is 10, her mother will be 10 plus 24, which is 34.
steps: The father is always 27 years older than Varun.
When Varun is 15, his father will be 15 plus 27, which is 42.
So his father will be 42 years old.

G4A_AGES_019.q: Rahul is 10 years old and his father is 40 years old. After how many years will the father be 3 times as old as Rahul?
hints: Both ages go up together. Try a number of years, find both new ages, and check whether one is 3 times the other.
Try each choice. After 10 years they would be 20 and 50. Is 50 equal to 3 times 20?
Example: a girl is 6 and her mother is 30. After 2 years they are 8 and 32, and 32 is 4 times 8, so after 2 years the mother is 4 times as old.
steps: After 5 years Rahul will be 10 plus 5, which is 15.
His father will be 40 plus 5, which is 45.
45 is 3 times 15, so the father is then 3 times as old. 3 times 15 equals 45.
So it happens after 5 years.

G4A_AGES_020.q: Ali is 14 years old and his sister Sara is 8 years old. How old was Ali when Sara was exactly half his age?
hints: The gap between their ages never changes. When one person is half the other's age, the younger one's age equals the gap.
Find the gap: 14 minus 8. When Sara's age was equal to this gap, Ali was twice as old as her.
Example: Ravi is 15 and Mala is 11, a gap of 4. When Mala was 4, Ravi was 4 plus 4, which is 8, exactly double.
steps: Ali is always 14 minus 8, which is 6 years older than Sara.
Sara is half Ali's age when her age equals the gap, so Sara was 6.
Ali was then 6 plus 6, which is 12.
So Ali was 12 years old.

G4A_AGES_021.q: Five years ago, a mother was 7 times as old as her daughter. The mother is 33 years old now. How old is the daughter now?
hints: Go back to the time the clue talks about, work out the ages then, and return to today.
Find the mother's age five years ago: 33 minus 5.
Example: four years ago a father was 6 times as old as his son. The father is 40 now, so he was 36 then and the son was 36 divided by 6, which is 6. Today the son is 6 plus 4, which is 10.
steps: Five years ago the mother was 33 minus 5, which is 28.
The daughter was then 28 divided by 7, which is 4.
Today the daughter is 4 plus 5, which is 9.
So the daughter is 9 years old now.

G4A_AGES_022.q: Aman is twice as old as Bhavna. Four years ago, Aman was three times as old as Bhavna was then. How old is Bhavna now?
hints: Two clues must both be true. Try an age, use the first clue to get the other age, then test the second clue.
Try a choice: if Bhavna is 12, Aman is 24. Four years ago they were 8 and 20. Is 20 three times 8?
Example: Meena is twice as old as Nitu, and five years ago she was three times as old. Try Nitu 10 and Meena 20: five years ago they were 5 and 15, and 15 is 3 times 5. So Nitu is 10.
steps: Try Bhavna as 8: then Aman is 2 times 8, which is 16.
Four years ago Bhavna was 8 minus 4, which is 4, and Aman was 16 minus 4, which is 12.
12 is 3 times 4, so both clues fit. 3 times 4 equals 12.
So Bhavna is 8 years old now.

G4A_AGES_023.q: A grandfather is 9 times as old as his grandson. Their ages add up to 70 years. How old will the grandfather be when the grandson is 10 years old?
hints: Use parts to find both ages now. Then move both people forward by the same number of years.
The grandson is 1 part and the grandfather is 9 parts, so 10 parts make 70. Find one part.
Example: a father is 5 times as old as his daughter and their ages add up to 36. Six parts make 36, so she is 6 and he is 30. When she is 8, two years later, he will be 30 plus 2, which is 32.
steps: The grandson is 1 part and the grandfather is 9 parts. 10 parts are 70, so one part is 70 divided by 10, which is 7.
The grandson is 7 and the grandfather is 9 times 7, which is 63.
The grandson will be 10 after 10 minus 7, which is 3 years.
63 plus 3 equals 66, so the grandfather will be 66 years old.

G4A_AGES_024.q: Neel says that in 6 years he will be twice as old as he was 2 years ago. How old is Neel now?
hints: Compare two moments: one in the past and one in the future. Count the years between them.
From 2 years ago to 6 years from now is 2 plus 6, which is 8 years. In those 8 years his age doubles.
Example: in 5 years Tanu will be twice as old as she was 1 year ago. Those moments are 6 years apart, so she was 6 one year ago, and she is 6 plus 1, which is 7 now.
steps: From 2 years ago to 6 years from now is 2 plus 6, which is 8 years.
His age doubles in those 8 years, so 2 years ago he was 8.
Now he is 8 plus 2, which is 10.
Check: in 6 years he will be 16, which is twice 8. So Neel is 10 years old now.

G4A_AGES_025.q: Three sisters were born 2 years apart, one after another. Their ages add up to 27 years. How old is the youngest sister?
hints: When ages are equally spaced, the middle one is the equal share. Find the middle age first.
Share 27 equally among the three sisters to find the middle sister's age: 27 divided by 3.
Example: three brothers born 3 years apart have ages adding up to 45. The middle one is 45 divided by 3, which is 15, so the youngest is 15 minus 3, which is 12.
steps: The middle sister's age is 27 divided by 3, which is 9.
The youngest is 2 years younger: 9 minus 2 equals 7.
Check: 7 plus 9 plus 11 equals 27.
So the youngest sister is 7 years old.

G4A_AGES_026.q: Five years ago, a family had 4 members and their average age was 19 years. Since then a baby has been born, and no one else has joined or left the family. Today the average age of the 5 members is 20 years. How old is the baby?
hints: Averages hide totals. Find the total of the ages five years ago, then think about how each person has changed since.
Five years ago the 4 members had a total age of 4 times 19, which is 76 years. Each of them is 5 years older now. What is their total today?

A similar one: 3 people averaged 20 two years ago, a total of 60. Now they total 60 plus 6, which is 66. With a new baby the 4 people average 17, a total of 68, so the baby is 68 minus 66, which is 2 years old.
steps: Find the total age of the 4 members five years ago. 4 times 19 equals 76.
Each of the 4 is now 5 years older. 76 plus 4 times 5 equals 96.
Find the total age of all 5 members today. 5 times 20 equals 100.
The baby's age is the difference. 100 minus 96 equals 4.
The baby is 4 years old.

G4A_AGES_027.q: The ages of a father, a mother and their son add up to 75 years. The son is 3 years old. Five years ago, what did the ages of this family add up to?
hints: Go back 5 years for each person separately. Check that each person had been born by then.
The son is 3 now. Where was he 5 years ago? Find what the father and mother add up to now, without the son.
A similar one: a mother, a father and a 2-year-old girl total 82 now. Four years ago the girl was not born. The parents total 80 now, and 4 years ago they totalled 80 minus 8, which is 72.
steps: The son is 3, so 5 years ago he was not yet born.
Find the parents' total now. 75 minus 3 equals 72.
Each parent was 5 years younger then. 72 minus 2 times 5 equals 62.
Five years ago the family's ages added up to 62 years.

G4A_AGES_028.q: When Meera was born, her mother was 26 years old. Today her mother is exactly 3 times as old as Meera. How old is her mother today?
hints: The gap between two people's ages never changes. Use the gap together with the times as old clue.
The mother is always 26 years older than Meera. If Meera's age is 1 part and her mother's is 3 parts, how many parts is the gap?
A similar one: a father was 30 when his son was born and is now 4 times as old. The gap of 30 is 3 parts, so one part is 10. The son is 10 and the father is 40.
steps: The mother is always 26 years older than Meera.
Meera's age is 1 part and her mother's is 3 parts, so the gap is 2 parts. 3 minus 1 equals 2.
Find one part, which is Meera's age. 26 divided by 2 equals 13.
The mother is 3 parts. 3 times 13 equals 39.
Her mother is 39 years old today.

G4A_AGES_029.q: Anu and Bela are 20 years old together. Bela and Charu are 26 years old together. Anu and Charu are 24 years old together. How old is Charu?
hints: Each child appears in two of the three totals. Think about what you get if you add all three totals.
Add 20, 26 and 24. Every child has been counted twice in this sum, so what do the three ages add up to?
A similar one: P and Q total 10, Q and R total 14, P and R total 12. The sum 36 counts everyone twice, so the three total 18. Then R is 18 minus 10, which is 8.
steps: Add the three totals. Each child is counted twice. 20 plus 26 plus 24 equals 70.
Halve to get the total of the three ages. 70 divided by 2 equals 35.
Anu and Bela make 20 of this, so the rest is Charu. 35 minus 20 equals 15.
Charu is 15 years old.

G4A_AGES_030.q: A father is 40 years old. His three children are 4, 6 and 8 years old. After how many years will the father's age be equal to the sum of the ages of his three children?
hints: Each year the father grows 1 year older, but the three children together grow 3 years older. Watch how fast the gap closes.
The children's ages add up to 18 now, so the gap is 40 minus 18, which is 22. How much smaller does this gap get every year?
A similar one: a mother is 30 and her two children are 5 and 7, a gap of 18. Each year the mother gains 1 and the children gain 2, so the gap closes by 1 a year and takes 18 years.
steps: Add the children's ages now. 4 plus 6 plus 8 equals 18.
Find the gap to the father's age. 40 minus 18 equals 22.
Each year the children gain 3 years in total and the father gains 1, so the gap closes by 2 years each year.
Find how long the gap takes to close. 22 divided by 2 equals 11.
Check: the father will be 51 and the children 15, 17 and 19, which add up to 51.
It will happen after 11 years.

G4A_AGES_031.q: A mother was 28 years old when her twin daughters were born. Today the ages of the mother and the two twins add up to 64 years. How old is each twin?
hints: Since the twins were born, three people have been growing older, not two. Count the mother too.
When the twins were born the three ages added up to 28. Every year after that, how much does the total grow?
A similar one: a father was 30 when his twin sons were born, and today the three ages total 60. The total has grown by 30, at 3 years each year, so 10 years have passed and each twin is 10.
steps: At the birth of the twins the three ages added up to 28.
Find how much the total has grown since then. 64 minus 28 equals 36.
Each year all three people grow a year older, so the total grows by 3. 36 divided by 3 equals 12.
Check: the mother is 40 and the twins are 12 and 12. 40 plus 12 plus 12 equals 64.
Each twin is 12 years old.

G4A_AGES_032.q: A father's age and his son's age are written with the same two digits, but in the opposite order. The father is 27 years older than his son, and the son is a teenager, 13 to 19 years old. How old is the father?
hints: Test the possible ages one by one. For each age, swap the digits and check both clues.
The son is between 13 and 19. Start with 13: the father would be 31, and 31 minus 13 equals 18. That gap is too small, so try the next age.
A similar one: a mother and daughter have ages with swapped digits, 36 years apart, and the daughter is under 20. Try 15 and 51: the gap is 36, so the mother is 51.
steps: List the son's possible ages, 13 to 19, with the digits swapped for the father: 31, 41, 51, 61, 71, 81, 91.
Find the gap for each pair: 18, 27, 36, 45, 54, 63, 72.
Only 14 and 41 have a gap of 27. 41 minus 14 equals 27.
The father is 41 years old.

G4A_AGES_033.q: Asha is 8 years old. She tells her older sister Bina: When I am as old as you are now, you will be 20 years old. How old is Bina now?
hints: The gap between the sisters stays the same. From 8 to Bina's age is one gap, and from Bina's age to 20 is the same gap again.
Asha needs some years to reach Bina's age. In those same years Bina grows to 20. So Bina's age is exactly in the middle of two numbers. Which two?
A similar one: Ravi is 6 and says that when he is as old as Sam is now, Sam will be 16. Sam's age is halfway between 6 and 16, which is 11. Check: in 5 years Ravi is 11 and Sam is 16.
steps: Asha needs a certain number of years to reach Bina's age. In those same years Bina reaches 20.
So from 8 to Bina's age and from Bina's age to 20 are two equal steps. Find the two steps together. 20 minus 8 equals 12.
Each step is half of that. 12 divided by 2 equals 6.
Bina's age is one step above 8. 8 plus 6 equals 14.
Check: in 6 years Asha is 14 and Bina is 20.
Bina is 14 years old now.

G4A_AGES_034.q: Ravi's age this year is a multiple of 3. Last year his age was a multiple of 4. Next year his age will be a multiple of 5. Ravi is less than 60 years old. How old is he this year?
hints: Three clues must all be true together. List the ages that fit one clue, then test them against the others.
Start with next year's age, which ends in 0 or 5. So this year's age ends in 9 or 4. Which of those are multiples of 3?
A similar one: an age is a multiple of 4, and one year later it is a multiple of 5, and it is under 20. Multiples of 4 are 4, 8, 12, 16. Adding 1 gives 5, 9, 13, 17, and only 5 fits. So the age is 4.
steps: Next year's age is a multiple of 5, so it ends in 0 or 5. This year's age ends in 9 or 4.
Ages under 60 that end in 9 or 4 and are multiples of 3 are 9, 24, 39 and 54.
Last year's ages would be 8, 23, 38 and 53. Only 8 is a multiple of 4.
Ravi is 9 years old this year.

G4A_AGES_035.q: Ritu and her two brothers are all more than 4 years old. Five years from now, their three ages will add up to 50 years. What did their three ages add up to 2 years ago?
hints: When time moves, every person's age moves. Count how many people there are and how many years you are moving.
From 5 years in the future back to today, each of the 3 children is 5 years younger. Find what the ages add up to today first.
A similar one: in 4 years, two sisters' ages will total 30. Today they total 30 minus 8, which is 22. Three years ago they totalled 22 minus 6, which is 16.
steps: Go back from 5 years ahead to today. Each of the 3 children is 5 years younger. 50 minus 3 times 5 equals 35.
Go back 2 more years. Each of the 3 children is 2 years younger. 35 minus 3 times 2 equals 29.
Two years ago their ages added up to 29 years.

G4A_AGES_036.q: A mother is 5 times as old as her daughter. In 6 years, their ages will add up to 60 years. How old is the daughter now?
hints: The times as old clue is about today, but the total is about the future. Bring the total back to today first.
In 6 years both the mother and the daughter will be 6 years older. Take both of those away from 60 to get today's total.
A similar one: a father is 4 times as old as his son, and in 5 years their ages will total 60. Today they total 60 minus 10, which is 50. That is 5 parts, so the son is 10 and the father is 40.
steps: Bring the total back to today. Two people are each 6 years younger. 60 minus 2 times 6 equals 48.
Today the daughter is 1 part and the mother is 5 parts. 1 plus 5 equals 6.
Find one part. 48 divided by 6 equals 8.
Check: 8 and 40 now, 14 and 46 in 6 years. 14 plus 46 equals 60.
The daughter is 8 years old now.

G4A_AGES_037.q: The ages of two cousins multiply to give 84. The older cousin is 5 years older than the younger one. What do their two ages add up to?
hints: List the pairs of numbers that multiply to give 84. Then look for the pair with the right gap.
Some pairs are 2 and 42, 3 and 28, 4 and 21. Keep going and find the gap between the two numbers in each pair.
A similar one: two ages multiply to 40 and are 3 apart. The pairs are 1 and 40, 2 and 20, 4 and 10, 5 and 8. Only 5 and 8 are 3 apart, and they add up to 13.
steps: List the pairs that multiply to 84: 1 and 84, 2 and 42, 3 and 28, 4 and 21, 6 and 14, 7 and 12.
Find the gap in each pair: 83, 40, 25, 17, 8 and 5.
Only 7 and 12 are 5 apart. 7 times 12 equals 84.
Add the two ages. 7 plus 12 equals 19.
Their ages add up to 19 years.

G4A_AGES_038.q: Kabir's age in months is the same number as his grandfather's age in years. Their ages add up to 78 years. How old is Kabir?
hints: Change both ages to the same unit. Think about how many months make one year.
If Kabir is 1 year old he is 12 months old, so his grandfather would be 12 years old. The grandfather's age is always how many times Kabir's age?

A similar one: a girl's age in months equals her aunt's age in years, and together they are 39 years. The aunt is 12 times as old, so there are 13 parts. One part is 3, so the girl is 3 and the aunt is 36.
steps: A year has 12 months, so Kabir's age in months is 12 times his age in years. His grandfather is 12 times as old as Kabir.
Kabir is 1 part and his grandfather is 12 parts. 1 plus 12 equals 13.
Find one part. 78 divided by 13 equals 6.
Check: Kabir is 6 years, which is 72 months, and his grandfather is 72 years. 6 plus 72 equals 78.
Kabir is 6 years old.

G4A_AGES_039.q: Tara's age and her uncle's age are in the ratio 2 is to 5. Six years ago, their ages were in the ratio 1 is to 4. How old is her uncle now?
hints: Ages in the ratio 2 is to 5 could be 2 and 5, 4 and 10, 6 and 15, and so on. Test these pairs against the clue about six years ago.
Both people must be older than 6. Try 8 and 20: six years ago they were 2 and 14. Is 14 exactly 4 times 2? If not, try the next pair.

A similar one: ages in the ratio 1 is to 3 now, and 1 is to 5 four years ago. Try 6 and 18: four years ago they were 2 and 14, which is 1 is to 7. Try 8 and 24: four years ago they were 4 and 20, which is 1 is to 5. So the ages are 8 and 24.
steps: List pairs in the ratio 2 is to 5 with both ages above 6: 8 and 20, 10 and 25, 12 and 30, 14 and 35, 16 and 40.
Take 6 years off each: 2 and 14, 4 and 19, 6 and 24, 8 and 29, 10 and 34.
Look for the pair where the second is 4 times the first. Only 6 and 24 fit.
That pair comes from 12 and 30, so her uncle is 30 years old now.
